title: Payment Extension Base by Disconnection Notice Stage
content:
# Payment Extension Base by Disconnection Notice Stage

**Table.** For a Payment Extension — the single-installment kind of Payment Arrangement — enrolled on a residential Electric Service Agreement whose status is disconnection notice pending, the extension base follows the notices delivered on that agreement:

| Notices delivered on the Electric Service Agreement | Extension base |
|---|---|
| A final notice | The agreement's whole account balance |
| A written notice, but no final notice | The past-due amount stated on its latest written notice |
| No notice | The agreement's past-due balance on the enrollment date |

The records read are the notices on the Electric Service Agreement — their type (written notice or final notice), their notice date and the past-due amount each states — and the agreement's account balance. Where several written notices were delivered, the latest by notice date is the one read.

## Cases (hypothetical agreement: account balance $731.90, past-due balance $498.65)

| Notices on file | Extension base |
|---|---|
| Written notice of March 2 stating $412.30, written notice of April 1 stating $455.10 | $455.10 |
| Written notice of April 1 stating $455.10, final notice of April 9 | $731.90 |
| None | $498.65 |
